# Parity fixtures

Real captures that the dissection is measured against, per column, with tshark as
the oracle. Everything in this directory except this file and `acceptance.json` is
**untracked**: the captures carry the author's DNS and SNI history and home addresses,
and so does the ground truth tshark derives from them
(`docs/decisions/0004-fixtures-and-privacy.md`). Keep a copy of the two `.pcap` files
somewhere other than `Downloads/`; they are the only copies.

| name | file | frames | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `inwire` | `inwire_capture_1788478187989.pcap` | 12,858 | `01f184b7ff5f1078460f08e64eb1a3944ffda89f961736488da8abfc2c427937` |
| `netview` | `netview_capture_1788426090876.pcap` | 14,782 | `2d20930051c0d1f91e5e40a1413ce5c7c73f432ad0e3f2c609789916a7b432e8` |

Both are Ethernet, snaplen 65535, microsecond timestamps, exported by the app itself.

## Files

- `<name>.pcap` - the capture, named as in `acceptance.json`.
- `<name>.psv`, `<name>-colors.psv` - tshark ground truth, regenerated by
  `./scripts/parity/regen-ground-truth.sh [name]` (two-pass, fields listed in
  `acceptance.json`). Regenerate after upgrading Wireshark and record the version.
- `acceptance.json` - tracked. Per fixture: the file, its hash, the per-column match
  floors the parity check holds the code to, and the counts tshark reports. A count
  is only enforced once its name is in `enforce`; the rest are printed as gaps.

## Running

```
./scripts/parity/regen-ground-truth.sh          # once, and after a Wireshark upgrade
npx tsx scripts/parity/parity-check.ts          # both fixtures, exit 1 on any regression
npx tsx scripts/parity/parity-check.ts inwire   # one
npx tsx scripts/parity/parity-check.ts --write-floors   # after a phase raises a column
```

`--write-floors` records each column's current match percentage (rounded down to one
decimal) as the new floor. Floors are only ever raised; a phase that lowers one has
regressed something and must say why in its gate notes.

Verify a capture before trusting a number:

```
sha256sum test/fixtures/*.pcap
```
